_comment: Locale registry — the single source of truth for every language the
platform speaks. Adding a fifth language means adding one entry here
plus one dictionary file (i18n/<code>.json). Nothing else in the build,
the runtime switcher, the CSS or the search index needs to change:
that is the 'extensible without redesign' requirement, enforced by
construction rather than by discipline.
Field notes:
pathPrefix  URL segment for this locale. The default locale owns the
bare root ('' -> /about/), others are prefixed
('/yo' -> /yo/about/). Derived, never hand-written per page.
dir         ltr | rtl. Drives <html dir>, logical-CSS flips, and the
breadcrumb separator direction.
intlLocale  BCP-47 tag handed to Intl.DateTimeFormat / NumberFormat.
Yoruba resolves to 'yo-NG'; where a runtime lacks Yoruba
data, numberFallback below is used instead of silently
rendering another language's month names.
fontStack   CSS custom-property value applied on [lang=..]. Yoruba needs
a face with real combining-diacritic support (tone marks
stacked over underdotted vowels) — see css/i18n.css.
hreflang    emitted in <link rel=alternate>; 'x-default' is emitted
separately for the default locale.
